cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer) RETURN c.category AS category, count(c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (s:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region) WHERE r.name CONTAINS 'Рівненськ' RETURN s.id AS substation, s.current_load AS load, s.capacity AS capacity, round(100.0 * s.current_load / s.capacity, 2) AS load_percent ORDER BY load_percent DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter) WHERE m.status IN ['faulty', 'broken', 'несправний'] OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) RETURN m.id AS meter, m.status AS status, c.id AS owner, s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
MATCH (m:Model)-[:GENERATES]->(f:Forecast) RETURN m.id AS model, m.type AS type, count(f) AS forecasts ORDER BY forecasts DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_5'})-[:USES]->(f:Forecast) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:FOR]->(s:Substation) RETURN f.id AS forecast, s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
MATCH (src:Substation {id: 'Substation_1'})-[:FEEDS*1..]->(s:Substation) WHERE s <> src RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
MATCH (m:Model)-[:GENERATES]->(f:Forecast) RETURN m.type AS model_type, avg(f.error) AS avg_error, count(f) AS forecasts ORDER BY avg_error LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) WHERE s.capacity > 0 AND s.current_load >= 0.85 * s.capacity RETURN c.id AS consumer, c.category AS category, s.id AS substation, round(100.0 * s.current_load / s.capacity, 2) AS load_percent ORDER BY load_percent DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer {id: 'Consumer_1002'}), (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_4'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((c)-[*..15]-(d)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rels, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 1
MATCH (w:Weather)-[:AFFECTS]->(m:Model) WHERE w.temperature < -10 RETURN DISTINCT m.id AS model, m.type AS type LIMIT 100
MATCH (s:Substation) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (f:Forecast)-[:FOR]->(s) } RETURN s.id AS substation LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter), (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region) WITH r.name AS region, count(m) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN m.status IN ['faulty', 'broken', 'несправний'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faulty RETURN region, total, faulty, round(100.0 * faulty / total, 2) AS faulty_percent ORDER BY faulty_percent DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (ms:Measurement) WHERE date(ms.timestamp) = date('2026-09-28') OPTIONAL MATCH (mt:Meter)-[:RECORDS]->(ms) RETURN ms.id AS measurement, mt.id AS meter, ms.timestamp AS timestamp, ms.value AS value ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 100

MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(s:Substation) MATCH (s)-[:FEEDS*0..]->(t:Substation) MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(t) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT c) AS consumers RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, size(consumers) AS affected_consumers, reduce(total = 0.0, x IN consumers | total + coalesce(x.contract_limit, 0)) AS total_contract_limit ORDER BY total_contract_limit DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(s:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, count(DISTINCT c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 1
